versions.changelog:
Initial release.

- Introduces a JavaScript-rendered web scraper using Playwright for dynamic page extraction.
- Supports scraping SPA, infinite-scroll, login-required, and Shadow DOM content.
- Offers configurable scraping parameters for scrolling, button-clicking, waits, and extraction formats.
- Includes error handling strategies and anti-crawling countermeasures.
- Provides template Python code for common web scraping scenarios.
- Structured output for easy integration and post-processing.
